entities.description: Chicago producer; with Phuture established acid house by repurposing the secondhand Roland TB-303 through real-time filter manipulation.

entities.description: Roland engineer; chief engineer of the TR-808; designer of the TB-303 and TR-909; member of the MIDI development team.

role_definitions.adopter: Early user of a device largely as its makers intended.
role_definitions.cultural_transformer: Establishes a new, consequential use for a device without having invented it.
role_definitions.entrepreneur: Builds the business infrastructure (labels, plants, stores).
role_definitions.innovator: Develops a novel technique or practice.
